items.title: Caterpillar (CAT) Stock Fair Value Falls As Analysts Cut Targets And Lift Rates
items.summary: Caterpillar’s modeled fair value has shifted lower from about US$902.34 to approximately US$815.26, trimming the stock’s implied upside in current research. Analysts link this reset to more conservative work on valuation, including higher discount rates and closer scrutiny of how AI, data center and construction demand might flow through to earnings over time. As you read on, you will see how this evolving narrative could shape the way you track Caterpillar from here. Analyst Price Targets...
